ex.en: The airline added extra flights to meet demand during the summer holiday season.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司增加了额外航班以满足暑期需求。

ex.en: A high-speed rail link connects the city center with the new international airport.
ex.zh: 一条高铁线路将市中心与新国际机场连接起来。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 通风的;宽敞明亮的;轻率的

phrases.m: (指戏剧演出等)大受观众欢迎

ex.en: Passengers were asked to keep the aisle clear during takeoff and landing.
ex.zh: 乘客被要求在起飞和降落期间保持过道畅通。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Her writing style is akin to that of the great nineteenth-century novelists.
ex.zh: 她的写作风格类似于十九世纪伟大小说家的风格。

senses: 表属于……的、具有……性质的，形容词词性；表行为，名词词性；表具有……性质的，形容词词性；表示状况，名词词性

alarm.usage: 同义 signal, warning；startle, frighten, shock；派生 alarming adj. 使人惊恐的，令人忧虑的；a（一）+l（联想“拉”）+arm（胳膊）→使劲拉警报器→警报（器）。；索引p402

ex.en: Lansley has alarmed health campaigners.
ex.zh: 兰斯利已经对健康运动者发出信号。

ex.en: The fire alarm sounded, and the building was emptied within three minutes.
ex.zh: 火警警报响起，大楼在三分钟内被疏散一空。

ex.en: Scientists expressed deep alarm at the rapid melting of Arctic sea ice.
ex.zh: 科学家对北极海冰迅速融化深表忧虑。

ex.en: The sudden rise in food prices alarmed many low-income households.
ex.zh: 食品价格突然上涨使许多低收入家庭感到恐慌。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adv. 让人担忧地,惊人地
adv. 令人惊恐地；让人担忧地

ex.en: Youth smoking rates have fallen, but vaping among teenagers is rising alarmingly.
ex.zh: 青少年吸烟率已经下降，但青少年吸电子烟的人数增长令人担忧。

senses: adj. 危言耸听的，骇人的
alarmist.usage: 联想记忆: 总是拉警报(alarm)的人(ist)容易危言耸听(alarmist)；索引p402

ex.en: This isn't to be alarmist.
ex.zh: 这不是危言耸听。

ex.en: But where is the evidence to support such alarmist advice?
ex.zh: 但这一危言耸听的建议有何证据呢？

ex.en: The reform achieved modest success, albeit at considerable political cost.
ex.zh: 这项改革取得了有限的成功，尽管付出了相当大的政治代价。

ex.en: The project was completed on time, albeit with a smaller budget than planned.
ex.zh: 项目按时完成了，尽管预算比计划有所缩减。

ex.en: The drug is effective, albeit with mild side effects.
ex.zh: 这种药物是有效的，尽管有轻微的副作用。

senses: n. 歌集唱片,集邮本,相册

ex.en: The band's latest album topped the charts within a week of its release.
ex.zh: 乐队的最新专辑在发行一周内就登上了排行榜榜首。

alcohol.usage: n.酒；酒精 military 的对于特定target 的perform 就像是展示muscle，这underlie 了国家的安全和ownership 的 完整，保证人民不被captive，这是强大国家的trait。在安全的土地上，才能建设；发音类似"一口喝"→酒；感情深一口闷

ex.en: Alcohol should only be consumed in moderation.
ex.zh: 酒只能适量饮用。

ex.en: Drivers found with any alcohol in their blood face an automatic ban.
ex.zh: 血液中被检出酒精的司机将自动被禁驾。

ex.en: The sale of alcohol to anyone under eighteen is strictly forbidden.
ex.zh: 严格禁止向十八岁以下者出售酒类。

ex.en: Research links heavy alcohol consumption to liver disease and several cancers.
ex.zh: 研究表明大量饮酒与肝病及若干癌症有关。

phrases.m: 警戒着,随时准备着,密切注意着

alert.usage: 发音类似“讹了他”→被讹一次后就变得很警惕。；串词记忆: alarm(报警器)能够向人们发出警告(alert)；索引p402

ex.en: There is a bomb alert, not only on the rail link but also on the M1 motorway running parallel to it.
ex.zh: 不仅在铁路线上，而且在与之平行的M1高速公路上都有炸弹警报。

ex.en: Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities.
ex.zh: 比如，嫉妒和愤怒可能已经变得能提醒我们注意重大的不平等现象。

ex.en: Doctors remain alert to any sign of infection after the operation.
ex.zh: 手术后医生们对任何感染迹象保持警惕。

ex.en: The police were alerted within minutes of the child being reported missing.
ex.zh: 孩子被报失踪几分钟后警方就接到了警报。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

senses: n. (尤指电脑程序)算法,运算法则

ex.en: The new algorithm detects fraudulent transactions within milliseconds of their occurrence.
ex.zh: 新算法能在欺诈交易发生后的几毫秒内将其识别出来。

senses: adj. ①陌生的；外国的，异域的
②(to) 不相容的，格格不入的；③(from) 性质不同的，异己的
n. 外国人，外侨；外星人，外星生物(c)
alien.usage: 同义 foreign；different, strange；派生 alienation n. (感情上的)疏远

ex.en: The film imagines a first meeting between humans and an alien civilization.
ex.zh: 这部电影想象了人类与外星文明的首次接触。

senses: v. ①排斥，疏远；使不友好；离间
alienate.usage: al-（其他）+en+-ate（动词后缀）→使属于其他人→使疏远

ex.en: Cutting staff benefits may alienate loyal employees and drive them to competitors.
ex.zh: 削减员工福利可能疏远忠诚的员工，并把他们推向竞争对手。

senses: v. 降落；从（公共汽车、火车等）下来
alight.usage: a(表示状态)+light(光)→表示光的一种状态→燃烧的

ex.en: A cigarette set the dry grass alight.
ex.zh: 一支香烟把干草点燃了。

senses: v. 使成一条直线;对准;校直

phrases.m: 公开支持(某组织、意见、人)

align.usage: 助记:align(对准)alien(陌生的)目标；词根记忆：a(表加强)+lign(line,形成行)→站队，与…站成一行→与…一致；索引p402

ex.en: On this, students' and colleges' incentives seem to be aligned.
ex.zh: 对此，学生和大学的动机似乎是一致的。

senses: adj. 相同的,相像的(表语形容词)
adv. 同样地,一视同仁地
alike.usage: alike作形容词时只作表语。；adj.相似的，相像的 adv.相似地；同样地

ex.en: They tried to treat all their children alike.
ex.zh: 他们尽量对自己的孩子一视同仁。

ex.en: The new regulation benefits employers and employees alike.
ex.zh: 新条例对雇主和雇员都有好处。

ex.en: The twins look remarkably alike, yet their personalities differ sharply.
ex.zh: 这对双胞胎长相极为相像，性格却截然不同。

ex.en: Fans and critics alike praised the young director's first film.
ex.zh: 影迷和评论家都称赞这位年轻导演的处女作。

senses: adj. 活着的(表语形容词)
alive.usage: alive只作表语；live作定语表示活的。；辨析:alive只做表语;live只做定语;living既可做表语又可做定语;alive多用于人,live只用于物；adj.活着的；仍然存在的

ex.en: Remarkably, all the passengers were found alive after the crash.
ex.zh: 奇迹般的是，坠机后所有乘客都被发现还活着。

ex.en: The old tradition is still very much alive in rural communities.
ex.zh: 这一古老传统在乡村社区仍然很有生命力。

ex.en: The debate kept the issue alive in the public mind.
ex.zh: 这场辩论使该问题一直留在公众的关注之中。

phrases.m: 几乎,差一点;除……之外其余都是

ex.en: All applicants must submit their forms online before the end of the month.
ex.zh: 所有申请者必须在月底前在线提交表格。

senses: n. [pl.] 所有想参加者；所有申请者

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: v. 减轻;消除(担忧、恐惧等)

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 指控；(无证据的)说法

ex.en: The newspaper denied the allegation that it had hacked the minister's phone.
ex.zh: 该报否认了其窃听部长电话的指控。

ex.en: An official investigation into the allegation of bribery is still under way.
ex.zh: 对贿赂指控的正式调查仍在进行之中。

ex.en: The senator resigned after fresh allegations about his finances surfaced.
ex.zh: 有关其财务的新指控曝光后，这位参议员辞职了。

senses: vt.（未提出证据而）断言；指控
v. （未提出证据）断言，指称，声称，指控
allege.usage: alleged 声称的；涉嫌的。；v.宣称，指控；发音联想：他声称(allege)自己能考上大学(college)；索引p402

ex.en: The prosecution alleges (that) she was driving carelessly.
ex.zh: 控方指控她粗心驾驶。

ex.en: Reporters allege that the company knowingly sold products that had failed safety tests.
ex.zh: 记者们声称，这家公司明知产品未通过安全检测仍加以销售。

ex.en: It is alleged that several officials accepted bribes from firms seeking public contracts.
ex.zh: 据称，数名官员收受了谋求公共合同的公司所送的贿赂。

ex.en: The alleged leak of customer data is being investigated by the data protection authority.
ex.zh: 数据保护机构正在调查这起据称的客户数据泄露事件。

senses: n. (对政党、宗教、统治者的)忠诚;效忠;拥戴
allegiance.usage: 辨析: allegiance 侧重指个人对国家、政党和宗教的忠诚；索引p402

ex.en: These terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning—and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm.
ex.zh: 正如另外一位教授凯什·库兰纳指出的，这些词语也试图给工作赋予意义，增进员工对公司的忠诚度。

senses: vt. 使(痛苦等)易于忍受,减轻,缓和
alleviate.usage: v.减轻，缓和；al（加强）+levi（变轻）+ate（动词后缀）→不断变轻→减轻。；索引p402

ex.en: A number of measures were taken to alleviate the problem.
ex.zh: 采取了一系列措施缓解这个问题。

ex.en: Toyota Motor, for example, alleviated some of the damage from its recall crisis earlier this year with a relatively quick and well-orchestrated social-media response campaign.
ex.zh: 以丰田汽车为例，该公司今年早些时候用一场相对迅速且精心策划的社交媒体回应活动，减轻了召回危机造成的部分损失。

ex.en: Gardening has been shown to alleviate stress and improve mood among office workers.
ex.zh: 事实证明，园艺能缓解办公室职员的压力并改善其情绪。

alliance.usage: 词根记忆：al(表加强)+li(bind,捆绑)+ance(名词后缀)→捆绑到一起，结为同盟→结盟；索引p402

ex.en: The Green Alliance was formed to campaign against environmental damage.
ex.zh: 绿色联盟的成立是为了开展反对破坏环境的运动。

ex.en: A native literary drama had been created, its alliance with the public playhouses established, and at least some of its great traditions had been begun.
ex.zh: 本土的文学戏剧艺术已经产生了，其与公众剧院的联盟关系也得以确立，至少，它的一些优秀传统已经初具雏形。

ex.en: The two parties formed a political alliance to push the education reforms through parliament.
ex.zh: 两党结成政治联盟，以推动教育改革在议会获得通过。

allocate.usage: 辨析：allocate 把……拨给；separate (人为地)分开；divide 将整体分成若干部分；detach 尤指拆开组合物体；派生 allocation n. 分配，分派，拨给；v.分配，分派，划拨；一再地（al）确定位置（locate）→确定把东西分配给谁；vt.分配例为2015年翻译；索引p402

ex.en: More resources are being allocated to the project.
ex.zh: 正在调拨更多的资源给这个项目。

ex.en: The effect is caused by the way we allocate our attention.
ex.zh: 这一效应是由我们分配注意力的方式引起的。

ex.en: City officials must decide how to allocate the limited budget between roads and schools.
ex.zh: 市政官员必须决定如何在道路和学校之间分配有限的预算。

senses: n. 分配；划拨的款项；分配的东西
allocation.usage: n.配给量，份额；分配，分派；索引p402

ex.en: The allocation of funds to rural schools has increased this year.
ex.zh: 今年拨给乡村学校的资金增加了。

ex.en: Critics question the fairness of the current allocation of medical resources.
ex.zh: 批评人士质疑当前医疗资源分配的公平性。

ex.en: Each department receives its budget allocation at the start of the fiscal year.
ex.zh: 每个部门在财政年度开始时获得预算拨款。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: v. 分配,配给(时间、钱财等),分派(任务等)
vt. 允许，容许，准许；给予；使有可能；接受；承认
allow.usage: allow of 容许。；同义 let, permit；admit；反义 disallow 拒绝承认，不允许；另 allow in 允许……进入；派生 allowable adj. 可允许的，可承认的

ex.en: The new rule does not allow employees to take holidays during the busy season.
ex.zh: 新规定不允许员工在旺季休假。

senses: n. 津贴，补贴；限额；免税额

phrases.m: (在做决定等时)考虑到某事;体谅或照顾别人

allowance.usage: n.津贴，补助；限额；allow(允许)+wan(玩)+ce(谐音“吃”)→允许用来吃和玩的钱→零花钱；make allowance for 考虑/体谅；allow 动词，allowance 名词。；索引p402

ex.en: There will now be a seven-day wait for the jobseeker's allowance.
ex.zh: 求职者领取津贴需要有一个七天的等待期。

ex.en: His parents give him a monthly allowance.
ex.zh: 他的父母每月给他零用钱。

ex.en: You must make allowances for his youth.
ex.zh: 你必须体谅他还年轻。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ally.usage: n.同盟国；盟友，支持者 v.与……结盟，与……联合；all（所有的）+y（联想成yes“是”）→所有人都同意→结盟→盟友。；索引p402

ex.en: Portugal is a traditional ally of England.
ex.zh: 葡萄牙是英国的传统盟友。

ex.en: The two nations remained close allies throughout the cold war.
ex.zh: 在整个冷战期间，这两个国家一直是紧密的盟友。

ex.en: Environmental groups have become powerful allies in the campaign against plastic waste.
ex.zh: 环保组织已成为反对塑料垃圾运动中的强大盟友。

ex.en: Almost half of the students surveyed said they had considered studying abroad.
ex.zh: 接受调查的学生中几乎有一半人说曾考虑出国留学。

senses: a./ad. 单独的（地）；孤独的（地）
a./ad. 孤独；独自；单独；只有；仅仅
adj. 单独的,独自的,独一无二的
alone.usage: leave sb alone 别打扰某人。

ex.en: The elderly man lives alone, and his only regular visitors are a nurse and a neighbor.
ex.zh: 这位老人独自生活，仅有的定期访客是一位护士和一位邻居。

ex.en: Cafes and small shops line the narrow street along the old canal.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆和小商店排列在旧运河旁的狭窄街道上。

senses: prep. 在……旁边,横靠,与……并肩
alongside.usage: prep.在……旁边；与……一 起；同时 adv.在旁边

ex.en: The new highway runs alongside the old railway line.
ex.zh: 新公路沿着旧铁路线延伸。

ex.en: Digital payments are growing rapidly alongside traditional cash transactions.
ex.zh: 数字支付与传统现金交易并行快速增长。

ex.en: She worked alongside experienced engineers on the bridge project.
ex.zh: 在桥梁工程中，她与经验丰富的工程师们并肩工作。

senses: adj./adv. 冷漠的（地）；超然的（地）

ex.en: Teachers encourage children to read aloud to improve their pronunciation and confidence.
ex.zh: 教师鼓励孩子们大声朗读，以提高发音水平和自信心。

ex.en: The exhibition traces how the modern alphabet developed from ancient picture symbols.
ex.zh: 该展览追溯了现代字母表如何从古代图形符号发展而来。

ex.en: The bridge, built in the 1930s, has already outlived its designed lifespan.
ex.zh: 这座建于20世纪30年代的桥梁已经超出了设计使用年限。

ex.en: The new policy has reduced costs, but it has also raised concerns about job security among employees.
ex.zh: 新政策降低了成本，但也引发了员工对工作保障的担忧。

alter.usage: alter与change辨析：alter指局部改变。；辨析：alter 指部分改变，原样仍可辨认；convert 转变、转化，可指改变信仰；fluctuate (价格等)波动；modify 小的改动、调整；派生 alteration n. 改变；alterable adj. 可改变的；/ ˌ ɔ ː ltə ˈ reɪ

ex.en: We often hear media reports that an unauthorized hacker has been able to access a computer database and to alter information stored there.
ex.zh: 我们经常听到媒体报道说，一个未经授权的黑客已经能够进入计算机数据库，并改变存储在那里的信息。

ex.en: They could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
ex.zh: 在等待搜查令到来的同时，他们（指执法者）可以采取合理的措施确保手机中的数据不被删除或更改。

ex.en: Scientists warn that climate change may permanently alter the ocean's ecosystems.
ex.zh: 科学家警告，气候变化可能永久性地改变海洋生态系统。

alternate.usage: 同义 change, rotate；periodic；反义 consecutive 连续的，连贯的；派生 alternation n. 交替，轮流，间隔；alter 的派生词

ex.en: They believed that the earth's climate alternated between periods of extreme cold and warm.
ex.zh: 他们认为地球的气候在极度寒冷和极度温暖之间交替变化。

phrases.p: have no alternative but to do sth.

alternative.usage: have no alternative but 除…外别无选择。；辨析：alternative 多指两者间选择；choice 从一系列人或物中挑选；option 强调选择的可能性；preference 基于个人偏好；派生 alternatively adv. 作为一种选择；n.可供选择的事物，替代 物 adj.可替代的

ex.en: What Washington does or doesn't do to promote alternative energy may mean less and less.
ex.zh: 美国政府在促进替代能源方面作为或不作为所产生的影响越来越小。

ex.en: For wild animals that cannot be returned to their natural habitats, zoos offer the best alternative.
ex.zh: 对于那些无法被放归回自己的自然栖息地的野生动物来说，动物园是最好的选择。

ex.en: With the trains fully booked, driving remained the only practical alternative.
ex.zh: 由于火车票全部售罄，开车成了唯一现实可行的替代选择。

senses: conj. 虽然；尽管；即使；不过；然而
although.usage: 不与but连用。；辨析:although比though语气强,较正式,多放句首;though在倒装句中不能与although互换；连词，后面接句子；例为2008年新题型；索引p402

ex.en: Although this is an interesting issue, it has nothing to do with the thesis, which explains how the setting influences Sammy's decision to quit his job.
ex.zh: 尽管这是一个有趣的话题，但它与论题所阐释的"环境如何影响萨米决定放弃自己的工作"没有任何关系。

ex.en: Although the experiment failed twice, the researchers refused to give up.
ex.zh: 尽管实验失败了两次，研究人员仍拒绝放弃。

ex.en: Although small in size, the startup has developed remarkably advanced technology.
ex.zh: 这家初创公司虽然规模不大，却研发出了相当先进的技术。

senses: n. 海拔，海拔高度；高处；高地
altitude.usage: altitude海拔；attitude态度；latitude纬度。；记：alt（高）+-itude（名词后缀）→高出海平面的垂直距离→海拔；助记:alt(high高的)+itude(名词后缀)→高度;~sickness高原病；有人说态度attitude决定了你的高度altitude

ex.en: We are flying at an altitude of 6,000 metres.
ex.zh: 我们的飞行高度是6000米。

ex.en: The aircraft suddenly lost altitude as it entered the storm.
ex.zh: 飞机进入暴风雨区域后突然下降了高度。

ex.en: Athletes train at high altitude to improve their endurance.
ex.zh: 运动员在高海拔地区训练以提高耐力。

senses: adv. 总共；完全；总而言之
altogether.usage: 辨析:altogether修饰形/副/动词表完全,修饰全句表总之,与not连用表部分否定;all together表所有人在一处

ex.en: The project was abandoned altogether when the funding dried up, leaving researchers deeply frustrated.
ex.zh: 资金枯竭后，该项目被彻底放弃，令研究人员倍感沮丧。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Some economists argue that charitable giving is rarely purely altruistic, since donors often gain social recognition.
ex.zh: 一些经济学家认为，慈善捐赠很少是纯粹利他的，因为捐赠者往往会获得社会认可。

senses: ad. 总是；每次都是；一直；一贯；老是，一再
adv. 永远,始终,总是,一直

ex.en: Customers do not always behave rationally, which makes market predictions extremely difficult.
ex.zh: 顾客并不总是理性行事，这使得市场预测变得极为困难。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. ①(艺术、科学等的)业余爱好者(c)
adj. 业余(爱好)的，外行的
amateur.usage: n.业余爱好者 adj.业余的，非职业的；ama（发音类似“爱莫”）+t（他）+eur→他爱莫能助，因为他是“业余的”，专业水平不够。拓展：an amateur singer 一名业余歌手；索引p402

ex.en: Moreover, the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
ex.zh: 而且，音乐评论的业余传统已经迅速走向衰落。

ex.en: Moreover, the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
ex.zh: 此外，业余音乐评论的传统也在迅速衰落。

ex.en: The tournament is open to both professional players and gifted amateurs.
ex.zh: 这项锦标赛向职业选手和有天赋的业余选手开放。

ex.en: His early photographs reveal an amateur's enthusiasm rather than professional skill.
ex.zh: 他早期的照片透露出的是业余爱好者的热情，而非专业技巧。

senses: vt. 使惊奇；使惊愕；使惊诧
v. 使惊奇；使惊愕；使惊诧
amaze.usage: amazing 令人惊奇的；amazed 感到惊讶的。；surprise 语义最弱；astonish 语义更强，指不可思议而惊讶；amaze 指对认为不可能的事极度惊愕，含惊叹佩服；发音类似“啊妹子”→多年未见的妹子变化好大→使惊奇；使惊诧

ex.en: We are amazed today at the mere number of plays produced.
ex.zh: 如今，单是戏剧创作数量就让我们惊讶了。

ex.en: It never ceases to amaze me how quickly children learn languages.
ex.zh: 儿童学习语言之快总让我惊叹不已。

ex.en: Visitors are amazed by the robot's ability to hold natural conversations.
ex.zh: 参观者对机器人进行自然对话的能力感到惊讶。

senses: adj. 令人惊异的；了不起的

ex.en: The networked computer is an amazing device.
ex.zh: 联网的计算机是一个了不起的设备。

ex.en: The former ambassador argued that cultural exchanges can ease tensions between the two nations.
ex.zh: 这位前大使认为，文化交流可以缓解两国之间的紧张关系。

senses: adj. 模棱两可的；引起歧义的
adj. 含糊不清的，模棱两可的，不明确的
adj. 模棱两可的，含混不清的；多义的
ambiguous.usage: amb（两）+ig（驱使，做）+uous（后缀）→两边都驱使做→模棱两可。；词根记忆：amb(around,转圈)+ig(drive,驾驶)+ous(形容词后缀)→思路像汽车一样转圈开→模棱两可的。；索引p402

ex.en: But discovery frequently follows an ambiguous and complicated route.
ex.zh: 然而，发现通常遵循一条模糊而复杂的路径。

ex.en: But in the everyday practice of science, discovery frequently follows an ambiguous and complicated route.
ex.zh: 但是在日常的科学实践当中，科学发现所遵循的规律常常模棱两可且十分复杂。

ex.en: The minister's ambiguous statement fuelled rumours of an early election.
ex.zh: 部长模棱两可的声明加剧了提前选举的传言。

ex.en: The wording of the clause is so ambiguous that both sides claim it supports them.
ex.zh: 该条款措辞如此含糊，双方都声称条款支持自己。

senses: n. ①(对名利等的)强烈欲望，野心(u)
ambition.usage: ambitious 有雄心的；ambition for 对…的抱负。；谐音法：发音类似“俺必胜”→我有必胜的决心→抱负，雄心。；发音类似“俺必胜”→我有必胜的决心→抱负，雄心；词根记忆: amb(around, 向各处)+it(go, 去)+ion→去向各处→四处游说→雄心；索引p402

ex.en: He left the bank in 2005 with ambitions to be a CEO.
ex.zh: 他一心想当总裁，在2005年离开了银行。

ex.en: The power and ambition of the giants of the digital economy is astonishing.
ex.zh: 数字经济巨头的实力和野心令人震惊。

ex.en: Her ambition to become a surgeon carried her through years of demanding training.
ex.zh: 成为外科医生的抱负支撑她完成了多年艰苦的训练。

senses: a. 有抱负的；有雄心的
a. 费力的；耗资巨大的
a. 有雄心的，有抱负的
adj. ①有雄心的，野心勃勃的
②费力的；耗时的；耗资的；艰巨的
adj. 有抱负的；有雄心的
ambitious.usage: 名词 ambition 雄心。近义：aspiring a. 有志向的；adj.有抱负的，野心勃勃的；费 劲的；规模宏大的；索引p402

ex.en: The government has launched an ambitious plan to cut carbon emissions by 2050.
ex.zh: 政府启动了一项雄心勃勃的计划，要在2050年前减少碳排放。

ex.en: He is ambitious and determined to rise to the top of the legal profession.
ex.zh: 他雄心勃勃，决心登上法律界的顶峰。

ex.en: Building the bridge in two years was an ambitious target that the engineers eventually met.
ex.zh: 两年内建成这座大桥是一个雄心勃勃的目标，工程师们最终实现了它。

ex.en: An ambulance arrived within minutes, and the injured driver was rushed to the nearest hospital.
ex.zh: 救护车几分钟内就赶到了，受伤的司机被迅速送往最近的医院。

amend.usage: [族] amendment n. 修正案；同义: revise, rectify, mend

ex.en: Parliament voted to amend the law so that online publishers would face stricter regulation.
ex.zh: 议会投票修订该法律，使在线出版商面临更严格的监管。

senses: n. （法律、文件的）修订，修改；修正案
amendment.usage: 词根记忆：a(away, 离开)+mend(fault, 错误)+ment(名词后缀)→把错误去掉→修订；索引p402

ex.en: The court has ruled that police don't violate the Fourth Amendment when they go through the wallet or pocketbook of an arrestee without a warrant.
ex.zh: 最高法院已经规定，警方在没有搜查令的情况下搜查被捕者的钱包或皮夹并没有违反宪法第四修正案。

senses: adj. 和蔼可亲的，友好的
adj. 亲切的,和蔼可亲的
adj. 和蔼可亲的，亲切的
amiable.usage: 派生amiability n.亲切;amiably adv.亲切地,和蔼可亲地；am（是）+i（我）+able（形容词后缀）→我是一个“和蔼可亲”的人。；索引p402

ex.en: Her parents seemed very amiable.
ex.zh: 她的父母看起来很和蔼可亲。

ex.en: Our new colleague is amiable and always willing to share practical advice.
ex.zh: 我们的新同事和蔼可亲，总是乐于分享实用的建议。

ex.en: Despite several heated exchanges, the talks ended in an amiable atmosphere.
ex.zh: 尽管有几番激烈交锋，会谈还是在友好的气氛中结束。

ex.en: The old professor greeted every student with an amiable smile.
ex.zh: 老教授面带亲切的微笑迎接每一位学生。

ex.en: The company announced its expansion amid growing doubts about the stability of the global economy.
ex.zh: 在全球经济稳定性疑虑日益加深之际，该公司宣布了扩张计划。

ex.en: Trust in public institutions has declined sharply, especially among younger voters.
ex.zh: 公众对公共机构的信任急剧下降，在年轻选民中尤为明显。

senses: vi. (to)达到……之多;(意义、效果、价值)等于……
amount.usage: amount修饰不可数名词。；n.数量；金额 v.达到，总计；等于；发展成；a（一座）+mount（山）→一座座山，到底有多少啊？→数量。

ex.en: During the course of trying various things, you will gain a large amount of social experience.
ex.zh: 在尝试各种事物的过程中，你会获得大量的社会经验。

ex.en: A large amount of public money was spent on the abandoned project.
ex.zh: 大量公共资金被花在了那个被放弃的项目上。

ex.en: Their weekly food bill amounts to nearly two hundred dollars.
ex.zh: 他们每周的食品账单总计将近两百美元。

ex.en: His silence on the scandal amounts to an admission of guilt.
ex.zh: 他对丑闻的沉默等于承认有过错。

senses: a. 足够的；丰裕的；硕大的；丰满的
ample.usage: 辨析: ample 充足且有余; sufficient/enough/adequate 刚好满足要求; 反义: scanty

ex.en: The report provides ample evidence that regular exercise improves both memory and mood.
ex.zh: 该报告提供了充分的证据，证明定期锻炼能改善记忆力和情绪。

amplify.usage: magnify 的近义词；辨析:amplify特指音量/电流增大;expand指范围体积扩大;extend指方向上延伸;enlarge指尺寸空间扩大；索引p402

ex.en: Social media can amplify both positive messages and harmful rumours.
ex.zh: 社交媒体既能放大正面信息，也能放大有害谣言。

ex.en: The new devices amplify weak signals from distant space probes.
ex.zh: 新设备能放大来自遥远太空探测器的微弱信号。

ex.en: Economic shocks tend to amplify existing inequalities within society.
ex.zh: 经济冲击往往会加剧社会内部已有的不平等。

senses: vt. 逗笑；逗乐；（提供）消遣
vt. 逗乐,逗笑,给……提供娱乐(或消遣)
amuse.usage: amusing 好笑的；amused 被逗乐的。；同义: delight, please, entertain; 反义: bore；v.逗乐，逗笑；消遣，娱乐；a(一)+muse(联想成mouse“老鼠”)→一只可爱的米老鼠把我们“逗乐”了

ex.en: The children were greatly amused by the monkey's endless tricks.
ex.zh: 孩子们被猴子没完没了的把戏逗得很开心。

ex.en: She amused herself with old magazines while waiting for the delayed train.
ex.zh: 等待晚点列车时，她翻看旧杂志自娱。

ex.en: His account of the camping trip amused the whole family.
ex.zh: 他讲述的露营趣事逗乐了全家人。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 时代错误;不合时代的人(或物)
a. 相似的；类似的；可比拟的

ex.en: The critic argued that the internet's impact is analogous to that of printing.
ex.zh: 这位评论家认为，互联网的影响可以与印刷术相类比。

ex.en: The structure of an atom is often described as analogous to the solar system.
ex.zh: 原子结构常被描述为与太阳系类似。

ex.en: The court found the two cases legally analogous and applied the same reasoning.
ex.zh: 法院认定这两个案件在法律上类似，并适用了同样的推理。

analogy.usage: an（一个）+a（一个）+logy（发音类似“逻辑”）→从一个逻辑推理到另一个逻辑叫“类比”推理→类比，类推。；索引p402

ex.en: The doctor drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
ex.zh: 这位医生把心脏比作泵。

ex.en: The teacher used an analogy to explain how electricity flows through wires.
ex.zh: 老师用类比来解释电流如何在导线中流动。

ex.en: By analogy with earlier reforms, experts predict strong local resistance.
ex.zh: 通过与早前改革的类比，专家们预计会遇到强烈的当地阻力。

senses: v. 分析；对……进行精神分析

ex.en: He analyses the weak lecture, learning lessons for the future about what works and what doesn't.
ex.zh: 他分析这次失败的演讲，为以后吸取教训，了解哪些可取，哪些不可取。

ex.en: College students' ratings of strawberry jams and college courses aligned better with experts' opinions when the students weren't asked to analyze their rationale.
ex.zh: 当大学生们没有被要求分析他们的理由时，他们对草莓果酱和大学课程的评价与专家的看法更为一致。

ex.en: Scientists analysed the soil samples for traces of industrial pollution.
ex.zh: 科学家分析了土壤样本中工业污染的痕迹。

ex.en: The great question is who should benefit from the analysis of all the data that our lives now generate.
ex.zh: 重要的问题是，谁应该从我们现今生活中产生的所有数据的分析中受益。

ex.en: A careful analysis of the data revealed serious flaws in the original experiment.
ex.zh: 对数据的仔细分析揭示了最初实验中的严重缺陷。

ex.en: The report offers a detailed analysis of why so many small firms fail within their first year.
ex.zh: 该报告详细分析了为何如此多的小企业在头一年就倒闭。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The financial analyst predicted a slowdown in the housing market.
ex.zh: 这位金融分析师预测住房市场将放缓。

ex.en: Political analysts are closely watching the outcome of the election.
ex.zh: 政治分析人士正密切关注选举结果。

ex.en: Market analysts attribute the price rise to reduced supply.
ex.zh: 市场分析师将价格上涨归因于供应减少。

analytical.usage: adj.善于分析的；分析的，分析 性的；索引p402

ex.en: The course aims to sharpen students' analytical thinking skills.
ex.zh: 这门课程旨在提高学生的分析思维能力。

ex.en: Chemists rely on analytical methods to identify unknown substances.
ex.zh: 化学家依靠分析方法来鉴定未知物质。

ex.en: An analytical approach helps managers break complex problems into manageable parts.
ex.zh: 分析性的方法帮助管理者把复杂问题分解为可处理的部分。

ex.en: Students who approach problems analytically tend to perform better on complex reasoning tasks.
ex.zh: 以分析方式处理问题的学生在复杂推理任务中往往表现更好。

senses: vt. 研究并找出（规律等）

phrases.p: analyze the cause of the problem

analyze.usage: ana-(完全)+lyz(松开)+-e→把整体分成部分→分解，分析；[族] analysis；vt.对……进行分析，解析

ex.en: Researchers analyzed decades of weather data to identify long-term patterns in rainfall.
ex.zh: 研究人员分析了数十年的气象数据，以识别降水的长期模式。

senses: 表性质，名词词性；表状态，名词词性
n. 祖先,祖宗;先驱;原型
ancestor.usage: descendant 后代。；派生ancestry祖先,世系;ancestral祖辈的；n.祖先；原型；索引p402

ex.en: Our earliest ancestors lived in a world fraught with danger.
ex.zh: 我们最早的祖先生活在一个充满危险的世界里。

ex.en: Scientists believe that modern birds evolved from ancestors shared with the dinosaurs.
ex.zh: 科学家认为，现代鸟类由与恐龙共同的祖先进化而来。

ex.en: This ancient tool may be an ancestor of the modern plough.
ex.zh: 这件古老的工具可能是现代犁的前身。

ex.en: Many urban workers return to their ancestral villages during the Spring Festival.
ex.zh: 许多城市劳动者在春节期间回到祖籍村庄。

ex.en: The tribe defended its ancestral lands against mining companies.
ex.zh: 这个部族为保护祖传土地而对抗矿业公司。

ex.en: He traced his ancestral roots back to seventeenth-century farmers.
ex.zh: 他把自己的家世追溯到了十七世纪的农民。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. [C-常用sing.,U] （统称）祖宗，祖先；列祖列宗

ex.en: Millions of people now use online records to trace their family ancestry.
ex.zh: 如今有数百万人利用网上档案追溯自己的家族血统。

ex.en: He is proud of an ancestry that includes several well-known writers.
ex.zh: 他的先辈中出过几位著名作家，他为此感到自豪。

ex.en: Genetic testing can reveal surprising facts about a person's ancestry.
ex.zh: 基因检测能揭示有关一个人祖先的惊人事实。

senses: n. [C] 锚；给人安全感之物
anchor.usage: 同义: fasten, attach, fix；索引p402

ex.en: The sailors dropped anchor in a quiet bay for the night.
ex.zh: 水手们在一个安静的海湾抛锚过夜。

ex.en: Strong family ties served as an anchor during his difficult years.
ex.zh: 在艰难的岁月里，牢固的亲情是他的精神支柱。

ex.en: The tents were anchored to the ground to resist the strong winds.
ex.zh: 帐篷被牢牢固定在地面上以抵御强风。

ancient.usage: ancient古老的；old年老的、旧的。；索引p402

ex.en: The term caravan was used to describe groups of people who travelled together across the ancient network for safety reasons, such as merchants, travellers or pilgrims.
ex.zh: 商队这个词常用来描述出于安全原因而同行在古代线路的人群,如商人、旅行者或朝圣者。

ex.en: Archaeologists uncovered an ancient tomb dating back three thousand years.
ex.zh: 考古学家发掘出一座距今三千年的古墓。

ex.en: The ancient custom of exchanging gifts survives in many rural communities.
ex.zh: 互赠礼物的古老习俗在许多农村社区保留至今。

ex.en: He refuses to replace his ancient laptop, which still runs the basic software.
ex.zh: 他不肯更换那台老旧的笔记本电脑，它仍能运行基本软件。

senses: conj. 和；而；加上；然后；于是；结果是；接连
conj. 然后,接着;那么,于是
and.usage: ⑦连接相同的词表示反复或连续:愈来愈

ex.en: The scheme cut energy bills and reduced carbon emissions at the same time.
ex.zh: 该计划既削减了能源开支，又同时减少了碳排放。

senses: a. 趣闻的；传闻的；逸事的

ex.en: Anecdotal reports suggest the drug works, but large clinical trials have yet to confirm this.
ex.zh: 传闻报道称这种药物有效，但大规模临床试验尚待证实。

anecdote.usage: 记：an-（没有）+ec-（向外）+dot（给）+e→向外界给出的未被证实的消息→传闻；派生anecdotal adj.轶事的,奇闻的；索引p402

ex.en: The lecturer opened with a humorous anecdote about his student years.
ex.zh: 演讲者以一个关于他学生时代的趣闻开场。

ex.en: Personal anecdotes, though vivid, cannot replace systematic evidence.
ex.zh: 个人轶事虽然生动，却不能替代系统性证据。

ex.en: Her biography is filled with amusing anecdotes about famous writers.
ex.zh: 她的传记里满是关于著名作家的趣闻轶事。

senses: 表有……性质的，形容词词性

angel.usage: 派生angelic天使般的;angelically天使般地

ex.en: Locals described the young volunteer as an angel who devoted her weekends to caring for the elderly.
ex.zh: 当地人形容这位年轻志愿者是一位天使，她把周末都用来照顾老人。

ex.en: The sudden layoffs aroused public anger, prompting the government to promise a full investigation.
ex.zh: 突然裁员激起了公众的愤怒，促使政府承诺展开全面调查。

senses: n. [C] （看待问题或形势的）角度

ex.en: You can look at the issue from many different angles.
ex.zh: 你可以从很多不同的角度看这个问题。

ex.en: The reporter approached the story from an entirely new angle.
ex.zh: 记者从一个全新的角度来处理这篇报道。

ex.en: The two walls meet at a sharp angle near the entrance.
ex.zh: 两面墙在入口附近成一个锐角相交。

ex.en: Residents grew angry when the factory repeatedly missed its deadline for reducing emissions.
ex.zh: 当工厂一再错过减排期限时，居民们变得愤怒起来。

senses: n. [U] （精神或肉体的）极度痛苦
n. (精神的或肉体的)极度痛苦,苦恼
v. 使痛苦,苦恼,悲痛;感到苦恼或(极度)悲痛

ex.en: The parents waited in anguish outside the operating theatre for several hours.
ex.zh: 父母们在手术室门外痛苦地等候了数小时。

ex.en: Experiments on animals remain controversial, even though they have led to major medical advances.
ex.zh: 动物实验仍然充满争议，尽管它们带来了重大的医学进步。

senses: vt. 使有活力；把…制作成动画

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 生气,活泼,热烈;动画片(制作)

ex.en: The studio's latest animation attracted huge audiences and won several international awards.
ex.zh: 这家工作室的最新动画吸引了大量观众，并赢得了多个国际奖项。

anniversary.usage: 助记:anni(year年)+vers(转)+ary(名词后缀)→周年纪念日；anni（=ann年）+vers（转）+ary（物）→一年转一次→周年纪念日

ex.en: The company is celebrating its 100-year anniversary this year.
ex.zh: 该公司今年庆祝成立100周年。

senses: v. 宣布...的到达(或出席)
announce.usage: 派生announcement宣布,通知;announcer宣告者,播音员；辨析：指以语言或文字首次公开地、正式地使人知道，常带有预告的意味；词根记忆：a(表加强)+(n)nounce(speak，讲话)→一再讲话→宣布；索引p402

ex.en: India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022."
ex.zh: 印度刚刚宣布其将“在2022年前消除国内所有一次性塑料制品”。

ex.en: The government announced new measures to reduce carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 政府宣布了减少碳排放的新措施。

ex.en: The company announced its plan to open offices in three Asian cities.
ex.zh: 该公司宣布了在三个亚洲城市开设办事处的计划。

senses: v. 使恼怒；使生气；骚扰
vt. 使恼怒；使心烦，打扰
annoy.usage: annoying 令人生气的。；同义: irritate; disturb, bother; 反义: comfort；v.使恼怒，使烦恼；打扰；发音类似“我恼”→使我烦恼，使我恼怒→使恼怒；使生气。；索引p402

ex.en: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.
ex.zh: 国内生产总值的问题及其实用性已经困扰决策者半个多世纪了。

ex.en: The constant noise from the construction site began to annoy the nearby residents.
ex.zh: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音开始使附近居民恼火。

ex.en: It annoys many commuters that trains are frequently delayed during rush hours.
ex.zh: 火车在高峰时段经常晚点，这让许多通勤者感到恼火。

ex.en: Commuters were annoyed by the repeated delays, yet few of them switched to public transport.
ex.zh: 通勤者对反复的延误感到恼火，但很少有人改乘公共交通。

senses: adj. 每年的,年度的,一年一次的
annual.usage: annually 每年地。；ann（一年）+ual（形容词后缀）→每年的，一年一次的

ex.en: Even so, that gain adds up to only 11.4 percent, lowest in American annual records except for the Depression years.
ex.zh: 即使如此，人口总数也只增加了11.4%，除了大萧条时期，这是美国年度记录中最低的增长率。

ex.en: The society holds its annual conference in Oxford every spring.
ex.zh: 该协会每年春天在牛津举行年会。

ex.en: Employees are entitled to twenty days of paid annual leave.
ex.zh: 员工享有二十天带薪年假。

anonymity.usage: 词根记忆: an(not, 无)+onym(name, 名字)+ity(名词后缀)→没有名字→匿名；索引p402

ex.en: The Internet affords anonymity to its users, a blessing to privacy and freedom of speech.
ex.zh: 互联网允许用户匿名登录，这对个人隐私和言论自由来说是件好事。

ex.en: The charity received a generous donation from an anonymous donor.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构收到了一位匿名捐助者的慷慨捐款。

ex.en: Peer review usually keeps the identities of reviewers anonymous.
ex.zh: 同行评审通常对评审人的身份保密。

ex.en: The writer published her first novel under an anonymous pen name.
ex.zh: 这位作家以一个匿名的笔名出版了她的第一部小说。

senses: a. 另一个的；再一个的
pron./det. 又一；再一；另一；类似的（人或事物）
adj. 另一,再一,别的,不同的
pron. 另一个,类似的一个

ex.en: One successful trial is encouraging, but another must be conducted before the vaccine is approved.
ex.zh: 一次成功的试验令人鼓舞，但在疫苗获批之前还必须进行另一次试验。

senses: n. 答复；答案；解决办法

ex.en: Scientists still cannot answer why some patients recover far faster than others.
ex.zh: 科学家们仍然无法回答为什么有些病人康复得更快。

senses: 表人，名词词性；表具有……性质的，形容词词性

ex.en: An ant colony can solve routing problems that challenge even advanced computer algorithms.
ex.zh: 蚁群能解决连先进计算机算法都难以应对的路径问题。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 对立的;敌对的;敌意的

antarctica.usage: 附录Ⅱ 大洲名；形容词 Antarctic

ex.en: The anthropologist spent two years living among the tribe to document its rituals.
ex.zh: 这位人类学家在部落中生活了两年，以记录其仪式。

senses: vt. 预期；期望；先于…行动
vt. 预期，期望；先于……行动
anticipate.usage: 后接动名词。；anti-（前）+cip（拿）+ate→提前拿到→预料。近义：expect vt. 预料；同义: expect, foresee, look forward to；词根记忆:anti(before,在…之前)+cip(take,拿,取)+ate(动词后缀)→在脑海里提前取得→预料；索引p402

ex.en: He anticipated something unusual would happen.
ex.zh: 他预感到不寻常的事将要发生。

ex.en: And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.
ex.zh: 而且预测所有可以想象得到的驾驶情况是一个很难的编程问题。

ex.en: The airline did not anticipate the sudden rise in fuel prices last winter.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司没有预料到去年冬天燃油价格的突然上涨。

phrases.p: the anticipation of possible shifts in demand
phrases.m: 对未来需求可能会发生变化的预测

anticipation.usage: n.预期，预料；期盼，期望；索引p402

ex.en: Fans waited outside the theatre in eager anticipation of the premiere.
ex.zh: 影迷们在剧院外热切期待着首映式的开始。

ex.en: In anticipation of rising demand, the factory added a second production line.
ex.zh: 为应对预期中的需求增长，工厂增设了第二条生产线。

ex.en: A good manager acts in anticipation of problems rather than in reaction to them.
ex.zh: 优秀的管理者未雨绸缪，而不是等问题出现后再被动应对。

senses: n. 〈美〉反贫困计划（尤指由政府倡导发起的计划）
antipoverty.usage: 联想记忆：anti(反对)+poverty(贫困)→反贫困的；索引p402

senses: adj. 古时的,因古老和稀少而珍贵的
n. 古物,古董;古式,古风
antique.usage: 发音类似“俺提个”→俺提个“古董”给老丈人送去，他就喜欢这种东西→古董。；索引p402

ex.en: Priceless antiques were destroyed in the fire.
ex.zh: 价值连城的古董在大火中焚毁。

ex.en: The dealer refused to reveal the price paid for the antique clock.
ex.zh: 商贩拒绝透露收购这座古董钟的价格。

ex.en: They furnished the farmhouse with antiques collected over thirty years.
ex.zh: 他们用三十年间收集的古董布置了这栋农舍。

ex.en: Collectors prize antique furniture for its craftsmanship rather than its comfort.
ex.zh: 收藏家看重古董家具的是工艺而非舒适。

senses: n. 焦虑的原因,担忧的事,心事
anxiety.usage: anxiety about/over 对…的忧虑。；anxi(痛苦)+ety→焦虑；[族] anxious a. 焦虑的；索引p402

ex.en: I had so much anxiety that I would wake up in the middle of the night and stare at the ceiling.
ex.zh: 我非常焦虑，以至于会在半夜醒来，盯着天花板看。

ex.en: I had so much anxiety that I would wake up in the middle of the night and stare at the ceiling.
ex.zh: 我特别焦虑，以至于常常半夜醒来，盯着天花板发愣。

ex.en: Job insecurity is a major source of anxiety for workers in declining industries.
ex.zh: 工作不稳定是衰落行业从业人员焦虑的一个主要来源。

ex.en: Many students suffer from anxiety in the weeks before important examinations.
ex.zh: 许多学生在重要考试前的几周里焦虑不安。

anxious.usage: adj.焦虑的，担心的；渴望的；索引p402

ex.en: To the anxious travelers the sight of the American shore brought almost inexpressible relief.
ex.zh: 对于心急如焚的移民们来说,看到美国海岸让他们如释重负,喜悦难以言表。

ex.en: Many of us are weighed down by the past or anxious about the future.
ex.zh: 我们中的许多人都被过去压得喘不过气来，或者对未来感到焦虑。

ex.en: Parents remain anxious about the safety of the new vaccines despite official assurances.
ex.zh: 尽管官方作出保证，家长们仍对新疫苗的安全性感到担忧。

senses: pron. 任一；任何一些；任何数量
adj. 任 何的,一些的;什么

phrases.m: 无论如何,不管怎样,反正

ex.en: The committee refused to release any details about the settlement before the hearing.
ex.zh: 委员会拒绝在听证会前公布有关和解协议的任何细节。

ex.en: The lecture was open to anybody interested in climate policy, completely free of charge.
ex.zh: 这场讲座向任何对气候政策感兴趣的人完全免费开放。

senses: ad. 尽管如此；至少；随便地；杂乱无章地
adv. 随随便便地;杂乱无章地

ex.en: The budget was strictly limited, but the team managed to finish the prototype anyhow.
ex.zh: 预算严格受限，但团队还是设法完成了原型机。

senses: pron. 任何人；随便哪个人；重要人物
pron. 任何东西；随便哪个东西；重要东西
pron./n. (but)除……外任何事(物);严重事情
adv. 在任何方面,程度上

ex.en: The minister denied that anything improper had occurred during the bidding process.
ex.zh: 部长否认在招标过程中发生了任何不当行为。

senses: ad. 而且；尽管；即使这样；反正；至少

ex.en: The evidence was incomplete; anyway, the committee decided to proceed with the review.
ex.zh: 证据并不完整；尽管如此，委员会还是决定继续进行审查。

senses: ad. 在任何地方；在（或去）任何地方
adv. 到(在)任何地方,无论哪里

ex.en: Smartphones have made information available almost anywhere, reshaping how people learn.
ex.zh: 智能手机使信息几乎在任何地方都能获取，改变了人们的学习方式。

senses: ad. （指空间或时间）相隔，相距；分开；成碎片
apart.usage: adj. 分离的;意见不一致的; 反义: together；一个一个(a)部分(part)的，那就是"分开的"→分离；索引p402

ex.en: Their birthdays are only three days apart.
ex.zh: 他们的生日仅隔三日。

ex.en: The two villages are only five miles apart, yet their dialects differ greatly.
ex.zh: 这两个村庄相距仅五英里，方言却大不相同。

ex.en: She stood apart from the crowd, quietly watching the celebration.
ex.zh: 她离开人群站在一旁，静静地看着庆典。

ex.en: The committee fell apart after its funding was cut in half.
ex.zh: 委员会的资金被削减一半后便四分五裂了。

apartment.usage: 助记:apart(分离)+ment(名词后缀)→分成几个部分→套间,公寓；apart(分离，分开)+ment(名词后缀)→分开的一个个单间，就是"公寓"

ex.en: I moved into a lovely little studio apartment.
ex.zh: 我搬进了一个可爱的小公寓。

ex.en: Rents for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre have doubled.
ex.zh: 市中心一套一居室公寓的租金翻了一番。

ex.en: They converted the old warehouse into spacious apartments.
ex.zh: 他们把旧仓库改造成了宽敞的公寓。

senses: v. 模仿,照搬(别人的做法)

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The airline issued a formal apology after the cancellation left hundreds of passengers stranded.
ex.zh: 航班取消导致数百名乘客滞留后，航空公司发表了正式道歉。

senses: n. (尤指政府或政党的)机构,组织
apparatus.usage: 助记:ap(加强)+par(准备)→仪器,装置;辨析:device指精巧较小的器具；appar（联想成 appear“出现”）+a（一个）+tus（吐丝）→出现一个“仪器”来完成吐丝的工作→仪器。

ex.en: Firefighters needed breathing apparatus to enter the burning house.
ex.zh: 消防队员需要呼吸器以便进入燃烧的大楼。

senses: adj. 显然的,明明白白的
adj. 表面上的,貌似(真实)的
apparent.usage: It is apparent that 显然…。；同义: distinct, obvious, evident, visible, clear; 反义: obscure；辨析：强调显而易见或一想便知；索引p402

ex.en: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of states.
ex.zh: 正是这种显而易见的政治超越性解释了君主们为何能作为国家元首继续受欢迎。

ex.en: It was apparent from his tired voice that he had not slept for days.
ex.zh: 从他疲惫的声音可以明显看出他已多日未眠。

ex.en: The calm on the surface was only apparent; the negotiations were near collapse.
ex.zh: 表面的平静只是假象；谈判实际上已濒临破裂。

ex.en: The cause of the delay soon became apparent to everyone in the office.
ex.zh: 办公室里每个人很快就明白了延误的原因。

senses: vi. 呼吁；上诉；有吸引力

phrases.p: appeal to sb. to do sth.

appeal.usage: appealing 有吸引力的。；辨析: appeal for 呼吁,强烈要求帮助; beg 乞讨,乞求; plead 求情以求宽恕或同意; call for 一般的要求；a(一个)+p(联想person人)+peal(联想plea请求)→一个人去请求大家做某件事→呼吁；2018年阅读例：Lower-income jo

ex.en: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision.
ex.zh: 联邦上诉法院推翻了之前的判决。

ex.en: Besides generating income, the presence of other marketers makes the site seem objective, gives companies opportunities to learn valuable information about the appeal of other companies' marketing, and may help expand user traffic for all companies concerned.
ex.zh: 其他营销者的存在除了可以带来收入，也能使该网站看起来客观公正，使企业有机会了解到有关其他公司市场营销独到之处的宝贵信息，可能有助于增加所有相关企业的用户流量。

ex.en: The charity launched an emergency appeal for the flood victims.
ex.zh: 慈善机构为洪水灾民发起了紧急募捐呼吁。

ex.en: Country life holds little appeal for young people seeking careers.
ex.zh: 乡村生活对寻求事业发展的年轻人几乎没有吸引力。

senses: adj. 有吸引力的；有感染力的；令人感兴趣的

appear.usage: appearance 出现；外观。；appear/seem都可表“似乎”，appear更强调视觉印象；①出现②出版，均出自2017年新题型；索引p403

ex.en: A survey found that 79% of I... consumers... appear...
ex.zh: 一项调查发现，79%的消费者似乎…

ex.en: ...it appears that unreasonable verdicts...
ex.zh: …不合理的判决似乎…

ex.en: When the recovery began, worker shortages first appeared in the high-skilled trades.
ex.zh: 当经济开始复苏，劳动力短缺最先出现在高技术含量的行业中。

appearance.usage: n.露面，演出；外观；出现；索引p403

ex.en: The singer's sudden appearance on stage delighted the waiting audience.
ex.zh: 歌手突然登台亮相让等候的观众欣喜不已。

ex.en: People should not be judged merely by their appearance.
ex.zh: 不应仅凭外貌评判一个人。

ex.en: The appearance of new factories along the river changed the town within a decade.
ex.zh: 沿河而起的工厂在十年间改变了这座小镇的面貌。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: v. 平息;安抚,抚慰;绥靖;姑息

phrases.m: 永远得不到满足的欲望

appetite.usage: 又:whip one's appetite for激起某人的欲望；ap（一再）+pet（寻找、追求）+ite（后缀）→一再追求→强烈欲望。；索引p403

ex.en: Technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs.
ex.zh: 技术在吞噬人类工作方面非常“贪得无厌”。

ex.en: The long walk in the mountains gave us all a healthy appetite.
ex.zh: 山间长途步行使我们个个食欲大增。

ex.en: The public seems to have an enormous appetite for stories about celebrities.
ex.zh: 公众对名人故事似乎有强烈的兴趣。

ex.en: Loss of appetite is among the earliest signs of the illness.
ex.zh: 食欲不振是这种疾病最早的征兆之一。

applaud.usage: applause 掌声。；ap(表加强)+plaud(鼓掌，拍手)→鼓掌，称赞；索引p403

ex.en: Some applaud the approach; others are concerned.
ex.zh: 一些人赞赏这种做法；其他人对此事表示担忧。

ex.en: The audience applauded warmly when the young pianist came on stage.
ex.zh: 年轻钢琴家登台时，观众热烈鼓掌。

ex.en: Environmental groups applauded the government's decision to ban plastic bags.
ex.zh: 环保组织对政府禁用塑料袋的决定表示赞许。

ex.en: We applaud her courage in publishing the results despite fierce opposition.
ex.zh: 我们赞赏她不顾激烈反对发表研究结果的勇气。

ex.en: The speaker paused for applause before presenting the final set of statistics.
ex.zh: 演讲者在展示最后一组统计数据前停下来等待掌声。

ex.en: The study found that eating an apple daily was associated with slightly lower cholesterol.
ex.zh: 研究发现，每天吃一个苹果与胆固醇略低存在关联。

appliance.usage: apply 的派生词。近义：device n. 装置，设备；[近] device n. 器具

ex.en: Caution! Don't turn on any electric appliance without permission.
ex.zh: 注意！未经许可不得擅自开启任何电器设备。

ex.en: Energy-efficient household appliances can sharply reduce electricity bills.
ex.zh: 节能家电能大幅减少电费开支。

ex.en: The store offers free delivery for any kitchen appliance over fifty pounds.
ex.zh: 该店对超过五十英镑的厨房电器提供免费送货。

applicable.usage: [族] applicability n. 适用性；[近] relevant a. 合适的；adj.适用的，适当的；索引p403

ex.en: The new rule is applicable to all firms with more than fifty employees.
ex.zh: 新规定适用于所有雇员超过五十人的公司。

ex.en: This discount is not applicable to items already on sale.
ex.zh: 本折扣不适用于已打折的商品。

ex.en: The committee questioned whether the findings were applicable to other regions.
ex.zh: 委员会质疑这些研究结果是否适用于其他地区。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 申请人(尤指求职、进高等学校等)

ex.en: Employers require applicants to submit very personal information on background checks.
ex.zh: 雇主要求求职者在背景调查中提交非常私人的信息。

ex.en: Each applicant is required to submit two letters of recommendation with the form.
ex.zh: 每位申请人都须随表格提交两封推荐信。

ex.en: The firm rejected more than half of the applicants for lacking relevant experience.
ex.zh: 该公司以缺乏相关经验为由拒绝了超过半数的申请者。

ex.en: Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.
ex.zh: 很多学生发现自己在大学申请上填的是一个专业，但是就读后却换成了另外一个专业。

ex.en: The application of artificial intelligence to medicine is changing the way doctors diagnose disease.
ex.zh: 人工智能在医学上的应用正在改变医生诊断疾病的方式。

ex.en: Her application for the research grant was turned down for a second time.
ex.zh: 她的科研经费申请第二次遭到拒绝。

apply.usage: application 申请；应用。applicant 申请人。；exert 的近义词；v.申请；应用，运用；适用；v.申请；涂，敷；应用，运用； 适用；②vi.涉及例(2020年阅读):GAFA tax设计上主要适用于谷歌、苹果、脸书、亚马逊；真题词组小记见本页；索引p403

ex.en: The new technology was applied to farming.
ex.zh: 这项新技术已应用于农业。

ex.en: We also need to admit good arguments by opponents and to apply the same critical standards to ourselves.
ex.zh: 我们也需要承认对手提出的好的论点，并对自身采用同样的评判标准。

ex.en: Students must apply online before the end of March to be considered for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 学生必须在三月底前在线申请，才有资格获得该奖学金。

appoint.usage: appointment 约会；任命。；同义: elect, nominate, name; assign；ap（一再地）+point（指着）→指着你说“你去干”→委任；索引p403

ex.en: In December of 1869, Congress appointed a commission to select a site and prepare plans and cost estimates for a new State Department Building.
ex.zh: 1869年12月，国会任命了一个委员会，负责为新的国务院大楼选址、制订计划和估算成本。

ex.en: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors.
ex.zh: 通过与美国统计协会合作，该杂志委任了七名专家组成了一个统计数据审核编辑委员会。

ex.en: The board voted to appoint an independent expert to review the safety procedures.
ex.zh: 董事会投票决定任命一名独立专家来审查安全规程。

senses: n. 任命,委托;职务,职位
n. 委任，任命；约会；职位
appointment.usage: n.约会，约定；任命，委派； 职位；索引p403

ex.en: I have an appointment with Tiechui tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我和铁锤有个约会。

ex.en: Once on the calendar, I protect this time like I would a doctor's appointment or important meeting.
ex.zh: 一旦(计划)上了日程表，我就会像对待与医生的预约或者一次重要的会议那样，严格保障这个时间。

ex.en: Her appointment as chief editor surprised many senior journalists in the newsroom.
ex.zh: 她被任命为主编，令编辑部里许多资深记者感到意外。

senses: n. 评价,估价,鉴定,评定

ex.en: Each employee receives an annual appraisal from the line manager.
ex.zh: 每名员工每年都接受直属经理的绩效评估。

ex.en: The bank sent an expert to make an appraisal of the property.
ex.zh: 银行派专家对这处房产进行估价。

ex.en: The book gives a fair appraisal of the reform's achievements and failures.
ex.zh: 这本书对改革的成就与失败作了公正的评价。

ex.en: An independent panel was hired to appraise the true value of the damaged artwork.
ex.zh: 人们聘请了一个独立小组来评估受损艺术品的真实价值。

appreciate.usage: 后接动名词，不接不定式。appreciation 感激；欣赏。；反义: depreciate；v.欣赏；理解；感激；升值， 增值；ap（一再地）+preci（=price价值）+ate→一再说其珍贵→重视；欣赏；词根记忆：ap(to,去)+preci(price,价格)+ate(动词后缀)→去给某物定价→欣赏。；索引p

ex.en: You're too superficial to appreciate great literature like this.
ex.zh: 你太肤浅，无法欣赏这类文学巨著。

ex.en: Remember in dealing with any coworker what they appreciate from an interaction.
ex.zh: 在与任何一位同事打交道时，记住他们欣赏的交流方式。

ex.en: appreciate the things you have
ex.zh: 感恩你所拥有的一切

ex.en: Sometimes years are required for truly novel discovery claims to be accepted and appreciated.
ex.zh: 有时候，真正全新的发现声明需要经过多年才能为人们所接受和认可。

senses: n. 欣赏；理解；感激；增值；鉴定

ex.en: Courses in art appreciation help students interpret paintings rather than merely observe them.
ex.zh: 艺术鉴赏课程帮助学生解读绘画，而不仅仅是观看。

appreciative.usage: adj.欣赏的，赞赏的；感激的；索引p403

ex.en: The audience was appreciative of the orchestra's effort, applauding long after the final note.
ex.zh: 观众很感激乐团的付出，在最后一个音符落下后仍掌声不断。

apprehension.usage: n.忧虑；逮捕；理解，领悟；索引p403

ex.en: Many employees felt apprehension about the merger, fearing layoffs in the coming months.
ex.zh: 许多员工对此次合并感到忧虑，担心未来几个月会被裁员。

approach.usage: 作名词表示方法时后接to。；ap-(去)+proach(近)→走近→接近；途径→方法；发音类似“饿，扑肉吃”，想扑肉吃先得靠近猎物→靠近；词根记忆：ap(表强调)+proach(near，接近)→接近；索引p403

ex.en: It was time to take a different approach.
ex.zh: 是时候采取不同的方法了。

ex.en: It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
ex.zh: 她说，只是个人的行动太缓慢，不足以成为改变普遍行为的唯一的，或者甚至可以说是主要的办法。

ex.en: The museum takes a hands-on approach to teaching children about science.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆采用动手实践的方法向儿童讲授科学。

ex.en: Winter is approaching, and farmers are racing to finish the harvest.
ex.zh: 冬天临近，农民们正抢着完成收割。

senses: adj. 平易近人的；友善的

ex.en: A good manager should be approachable, so that staff feel safe reporting problems early.
ex.zh: 优秀的管理者应当平易近人，让员工敢于及早报告问题。

appropriate.usage: fit 对某意图、场合合适；appropriate 适合某地位、身份、场合；suitable 符合某要求；apt 自然恰当，含主动意味；proper 生来适宜；ap(加强)+propr(proper适当)+i+ate(形容词后缀)→合适的；动词读[ə'prəʊprieɪt]；索引p403

ex.en: Meanwhile, this policy does nothing to ensure that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject.
ex.zh: 与此同时，这一政策并不能确保学生收到的家庭作业是有意义的，或者适合他们的年龄和学科。

ex.en: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women—whether CEOs or their children's caregivers—and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.
ex.zh: 如果有适当的公共政策来帮助所有女性——不管是首席执行官还是她们孩子的保姆——以及所有家庭，在一个更为公平的社会，桑德伯格就会和其他卓越人士一样，也就没有什么新闻价值了。

ex.en: Jeans are not appropriate clothes for a formal job interview.
ex.zh: 牛仔裤不适合在正式求职面试时穿。

ex.en: It would not be appropriate for me to comment before the trial ends.
ex.zh: 在庭审结束前我发表评论并不合适。

senses: n. (of) 赞成，批准，同意，认可(u)
approval.usage: n.称许，赞成；批准，许可；索引p403

ex.en: It is not easy to get the approval of authorities.
ex.zh: 得到官方的批准不容易。

ex.en: The new drug will not reach the market until it wins approval from the regulators.
ex.zh: 这种新药在获得监管机构批准之前不会上市。

ex.en: The government's housing policy won broad public approval across the country.
ex.zh: 政府的住房政策在全国赢得了公众的广泛赞同。

approve.usage: approval 批准；赞成。；ap(加强)+prove(证明)→一再证明可行→得到同意、赞成；派生approval n.赞成；批准；索引p403

ex.en: More than two-thirds of young Americans disapprove of President Trump's use of Twitter.
ex.zh: 超过三分之二的美国年轻人不赞成特朗普总统使用推特。

ex.en: Instead of each province having its own list of approved drugs, bureaucracy, procedures and limited bargaining power, all would pool resources, work with Ottawa, and create a national institution.
ex.zh: 各省不再有自己批准的药品清单、管理机构、手续以及有限的议价权，取而代之的是把所有的资源整合起来，与渥太华协作，建立一个全国性的机构。

ex.en: The committee finally approved the plan after months of heated debate.
ex.zh: 经过数月的激烈辩论，委员会最终批准了该计划。

approximate.usage: 派生approximation近似值,概算;接近,近似;approximately大约地,近似地；结婚前他不断接近approximate女朋友mate，最后才交往

ex.en: Still, Jefferson freed Hemings's children—though not Hemings herself or his approximately 150 other slaves.
ex.zh: 尽管如此，杰斐逊还是释放了海明斯的孩子们，虽然没有释放海明斯本人和其他大约150名奴隶。

ex.en: Please give me an approximate figure for the total cost.
ex.zh: 请给我一个总成本的近似数字。

ex.en: The model can only approximate real market behaviour.
ex.zh: 该模型只能近似地模拟真实的市场行为。

approximately.usage: 词根记忆：ap(表加强)+prox(near,接近)+imate+ly(副词后缀)→大约；索引p403

ex.en: The journey takes approximately three hours by high-speed train.
ex.zh: 乘高速火车旅行大约需要三个小时。

ex.en: Approximately 60 percent of the students come from overseas.
ex.zh: 大约百分之六十的学生来自海外。

ex.en: The population of the metropolitan area is approximately eight million.
ex.zh: 该大都市区的人口约为八百万。

ex.en: The tax reforms announced in April will take effect at the start of the next fiscal year.
ex.zh: 四月宣布的税制改革将于下一财政年度开始时生效。

books.unit: 51 当你了解更多，会有更多选择；52 “选择”相关词汇

senses: adj. 易于…的；恰当的；聪明的
adj. ①(习性)易于……的，有……倾向的
apt.usage: [近] liable a. 易于……的 [近] prone a. 有……倾向的；likely 意为很可能、可期待；apt 指易于……的、有……倾向的，表示一般或普遍的行为；prone 指倾向于……，常用于人；这只猿猴（ape）有扑倒它的倾向（apt）。；索引p403

ex.en: The song would have been more apt for a bass voice.
ex.zh: 这首歌更适合男低音。

ex.en: Babies are apt to put objects into their mouths.
ex.zh: 婴儿爱把东西往嘴里塞。

ex.en: Milk is apt to turn sour quickly in hot weather.
ex.zh: 热天牛奶容易很快变酸。

ex.en: The lecturer chose a particularly apt example to illustrate the theory.
ex.zh: 讲师选了一个非常贴切的例子来说明这一理论。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 水栖的,水生的;水上的,水中(进行)的

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类
历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. [C] 仲裁人；公断人；权威人士
n. 仲裁人;公断人;决定者;权威人士

ex.en: Courts, not private firms, should act as the final arbiter in disputes over data ownership.
ex.zh: 在数据所有权纠纷中，应当由法院而非私人企业担任最终仲裁者。

senses: adj. 随心所欲的,个人武断的,专断的,任意的
adj. 任意的，武断的，随心所欲的
arbitrary.usage: 记：arbitr（判断）+-ary（形容词后缀）→不加思考就随意做出判断的→武断的；助记:arbitr(judge判断)+ary(形容词后缀)→专断的；索引p403

ex.en: Good parents do not make an arbitrary judgement about their children.
ex.zh: 好的父母不会对他们的孩子作出武断的评价。

ex.en: Critics say the selection process was arbitrary and lacked transparency.
ex.zh: 批评者说，遴选过程武断随意，缺乏透明度。

ex.en: Prices here seem arbitrary, changing from day to day without explanation.
ex.zh: 这里的定价似乎很随意，天天变动却没有任何解释。

ex.en: No official should exercise arbitrary power over ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 任何官员都不应对普通公民滥施专断权力。

ex.en: The stone arch, built in the eighteenth century, is the town's oldest surviving structure.
ex.zh: 这座建于十八世纪的石拱门是该镇现存最古老的建筑。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 考古学的,考古学上的

ex.en: The archaeological site has yielded pottery dating back three thousand years.
ex.zh: 这处考古遗址出土了三千年前的陶器。

ex.en: New archaeological evidence challenges long-held assumptions about the city's origins.
ex.zh: 新的考古证据挑战了关于这座城市起源的长期假设。

ex.en: Construction was halted when workers uncovered archaeological remains.
ex.zh: 工人们发掘出考古遗迹后，施工随即停止。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Archaeologists have discovered an ancient tomb beneath the temple ruins.
ex.zh: 考古学家在神庙遗址下发现了一座古墓。

ex.en: The archaeologist spent a decade excavating the desert settlement.
ex.zh: 这位考古学家花了十年时间发掘那处沙漠聚落遗址。

ex.en: Modern archaeologists rely on satellite images to locate buried structures.
ex.zh: 现代考古学家依靠卫星图像来定位埋藏的建筑。

ex.en: Advances in archaeology have revealed how ancient trade routes connected distant civilizations.
ex.zh: 考古学的进步揭示了古代贸易路线如何连接遥远的文明。

senses: n. 建筑师；设计师；缔造者，创造者
architect.usage: architecture 建筑学；建筑风格。；记：archi-(主要的)+tect(建造者)→以建筑设计为主要工作→建筑师；[族]architecture n.建筑学；architectural a.建筑学的；词根记忆: archi(chief, 主要的)+tect(builder, 建筑者)→建筑者的首领→建筑师；索

ex.en: modern architects
ex.zh: 现代建筑师

ex.en: The house was designed by architect Louis Kahn.
ex.zh: 这所房子是由建筑师路易斯·卡恩设计的。

ex.en: The new concert hall was designed by a world-famous architect.
ex.zh: 新音乐厅由一位世界闻名的建筑师设计。

ex.en: She is widely regarded as the chief architect of the peace agreement.
ex.zh: 她被普遍视为该和平协议的主要设计者。

senses: n. 建筑学；建筑设计或风格
n. 建筑风格；结构；建筑学
architecture.usage: n.建筑风格；建筑学；结构；ar（联想成art"艺术"）+chi+tecture（联想成structure"结构"）→研究结构的艺术→建筑学；索引p403

ex.en: There are examples of most styles of architecture in the town.
ex.zh: 镇上有许多建筑风格的例子。

ex.en: She studied architecture for four years before joining a design firm in London.
ex.zh: 她学了四年建筑学，然后加入了伦敦的一家设计公司。

ex.en: Modern architecture often favours simple lines and glass surfaces over decorative details.
ex.zh: 现代建筑往往偏爱简洁的线条和玻璃立面，而非装饰性细节。

senses: n. 档案，档案馆，档案室

ex.en: Historians gained access to a national archive containing letters from the colonial period.
ex.zh: 历史学家获准查阅一份收有殖民时期信件的国家档案。

senses: n. 地区；场地；部位；领域；面积
area.usage: region 指较大的地理或行政区划的地区；zone 指特定的地带；area 泛指任意范围的地区

ex.en: The government plans to invest heavily in the area of renewable energy over the next decade.
ex.zh: 政府计划在未来十年内大力投资可再生能源领域。

senses: n. ①圆形运动场，圆形剧场
②斗争场所，竞争舞台，活动场所

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

senses: v. 争论，辩论，主张，说服

ex.en: The researchers also argued that when we shy away from casual interactions with strangers, it is often due to a misplaced anxiety that they might not want to talk to us.
ex.zh: 研究人员还提出，如果我们避免与陌生人随意交流，通常是因为我们会有不必要的担心，认为他们可能不想和我们说话。

ex.en: Some scholars argue that homework does little to improve young children's performance.
ex.zh: 一些学者认为，家庭作业对提高幼儿的成绩作用甚微。

ex.en: The lawyers argued for hours over the admissibility of the evidence.
ex.zh: 律师们就证据的可采性辩论了数小时。

senses: n. 争论，辩论；论据，论点
n. 争论，争吵；辩论；论点；论据；理由

ex.en: This is not an argument against target-setting.
ex.zh: 这不能作为反对设定目标的论据。

ex.en: The two economists had a fierce argument over the causes of inflation.
ex.zh: 两位经济学家就通货膨胀的成因发生了激烈争论。

ex.en: The central argument of the book is that growth alone cannot end poverty.
ex.zh: 本书的核心论点是：仅靠增长无法消除贫困。

ex.en: There is a strong argument for extending free childcare to all families.
ex.zh: 有充分理由支持向所有家庭提供免费托育。

arise.usage: 过去式arose，过去分词arisen。；v.产生，出现；起源；起立； 上升；a(一个)+rise(升起)→一个太阳升起的景象“出现”了；辨析：不及物动词，过去式arose，过去分词arisen，含义为“产生，出现”；索引p403

ex.en: It is speculated that gardens arise from a basic human need in the individuals who made them.
ex.zh: 据推测，花园源于创造者的一种基本的人类需求。

ex.en: But after the war, great social and political changes arising out of the successful war against Fascism created a growing demand in European and American economies for increasing numbers of graduates with more than a secondary school education.
ex.zh: 但第二次世界大战后，反法西斯战争的胜利带来了巨大的社会变化和政治变革，在欧美经济体中，亟需越来越多的具有中学教育程度以上的毕业生。

ex.en: Legal disputes may arise when the terms of a contract are vaguely worded.
ex.zh: 当合同条款措辞含糊时，就可能产生法律纠纷。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

aristocratic.usage: adj.贵族的；词根记忆：aristo(noblest, 最高贵的)+crat(government, 统治)+ic→贵族统治的→贵族的；索引p403

ex.en: The palace reflects the aristocratic lifestyle of the eighteenth century.
ex.zh: 这座宫殿反映了十八世纪贵族的生活方式。

ex.en: His aristocratic manners revealed his upbringing immediately.
ex.zh: 他的贵族举止立刻显露出他的出身教养。

ex.en: Many aristocratic families lost their estates after the war.
ex.zh: 战后许多贵族家庭失去了他们的地产。

ex.en: Pupils who struggle with basic arithmetic often lose confidence when facing advanced mathematics.
ex.zh: 在基本算术上吃力的学生在面对高等数学时往往会失去信心。

arm.usage: arms 武器。；with open arms热情而高兴地接待(欢迎)

ex.en: He broke his arm during training, but recovered in time for the championship.
ex.zh: 他在训练中摔断了手臂，但及时康复赶上了锦标赛。

ex.en: An army of volunteers was mobilized to distribute food and water after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水过后，一大批志愿者被动员起来分发食物和水。

ex.en: The company hopes to raise around ten million dollars in funding.
ex.zh: 该公司希望筹集大约一千万美元的资金。

ex.en: The children gathered around the teacher to hear the story.
ex.zh: 孩子们围在老师身边听故事。

ex.en: There has long been a shortage of skilled workers around the country.
ex.zh: 全国各地长期以来一直缺乏技术工人。

arouse.usage: arouse激起（抽象）；rouse唤醒。；evoke 的近义词；arouse 唤醒、引起，及物；rise 升起，不及物；raise 举起、提高，及物；arise 出现、起因于；rouse 唤醒，宾语通常是人；辨析：及物动词，过去式和过去分词均为aroused，含义为“激起，引起(感情、态度)”；索引p403

ex.en: The idea arose because of the perplexing behavior of the women in the plant.
ex.zh: 这个想法的产生是因为工厂里女性的令人迷惑的行为。

ex.en: The speech aroused strong feelings among the striking miners.
ex.zh: 这篇演讲在罢工矿工中激起了强烈情绪。

ex.en: The leaked report aroused fresh public concern about food safety.
ex.zh: 泄露的报告激起了公众对食品安全新的担忧。

ex.en: The loud knocking on the door aroused him from a deep sleep.
ex.zh: 响亮的敲门声把他从酣睡中唤醒。

arrange.usage: arrangement 安排。；[族]arrangement 安排；筹备；[近]plan 精心安排；arrange with...to do与...商定,谈妥;助记:ar(加强)+range(rank行列)→排列；v.安排，筹备；整理，布置；ar(表示"一再地")+range(范围)→一再地在一个范围内"安排"事情→安

ex.en: She helped him arrange the furniture.
ex.zh: 她帮他整理家具。

ex.en: The travel agency will arrange accommodation and flights for the conference attendees.
ex.zh: 旅行社将为与会者安排住宿和航班。

ex.en: The books are arranged according to subject rather than publication date.
ex.zh: 这些书按主题而非出版日期排列。

senses: n. 安排，筹备，整理；布置；约定

ex.en: The travel agency made all the arrangements for the conference trip.
ex.zh: 旅行社为会议出行做好了一切安排。

ex.en: By special arrangement, employees may work from home two days a week.
ex.zh: 经特别安排，员工每周可以居家办公两天。

ex.en: The arrangement of furniture can influence how spacious a room feels.
ex.zh: 家具的布置会影响房间给人的宽敞感。

senses: n. ①显眼的一系列，大量
vt. ①部署(尤指兵力等)；②穿着，打扮
n. 大群，大量；数组，阵列
array.usage: n.一系列，大量；数组，阵列 v.布置，排列；配置；在光线(ray)下排列(array)好这些物品；索引p403

ex.en: These two academics use an array of behavioral research to show that the most rewarding ways to spend money can be counterintuitive.
ex.zh: 这两位学者利用一系列的行为学研究表明，最让人受益的消费方式可能是与直觉相反的。

ex.en: The museum stores an impressive array of paintings collected from different countries over the past two centuries.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了过去两个世纪从不同国家收集来的一系列令人赞叹的绘画作品。

ex.en: Shops arrayed their goods along both sides of the narrow street to attract customers before the holiday season began.
ex.zh: 商店在狭窄街道的两侧陈列商品，以期在假日季开始前吸引顾客。

arrest.usage: [族] arrester n. 逮捕者 [近] apprehend vt. 逮捕；拘押；be(put)under house arrest被软禁;助记:ar(加强)+rest(休息)→强制休息→逮捕；ar（=ad，使）+rest（休息，停止）→使停止→逮捕他，使他停止犯罪活动→逮捕，拘留；索引p403

ex.en: An unusual noise arrested his attention.
ex.zh: 一阵不寻常的嘈杂声引起了他的注意。

ex.en: California has asked the justices to refrain from a sweeping ruling, particularly one that upsets the old assumptions that authorities may search through the possessions of suspects at the time of their arrest.
ex.zh: 加利福尼亚州已经要求法官们避免做出以偏概全的裁决，尤其是一项裁决推翻了当局在逮捕嫌犯时可以搜查其财物的传统设想。

ex.en: The police arrested the manager on suspicion of accepting bribes from several building companies last year.
ex.zh: 警方以涉嫌去年收受多家建筑公司贿赂为由逮捕了这名经理。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 被逮捕者,被拘留者

ex.en: The arrestee was released after the police found no convincing evidence.
ex.zh: 警方未发现确凿证据后，这名被逮捕者获释了。

ex.en: Each arrestee must be informed of the right to remain silent.
ex.zh: 每名被捕者都必须被告知保持沉默的权利。

ex.en: Records show that most arrestees were charged with minor offences.
ex.zh: 记录显示，大多数被捕者被控的罪名较轻。

ex.en: The arrival of low-cost airlines has transformed tourism in remote coastal regions.
ex.zh: 廉价航空的到来改变了偏远沿海地区的旅游业。

arrive.usage: arrive at a conclusion 得出结论。

ex.en: The researchers arrived at a different conclusion after re-examining the raw data.
ex.zh: 研究人员在重新检查原始数据后得出了不同的结论。

arrogant.usage: 派生arrogance傲慢,自大;助记:ar+rog(ask要求)+ant→要求多的→自大的；发音类似"俺要干他(打他)"→对人傲慢让人想打他；索引p403

ex.en: He was a rude, arrogant young man.
ex.zh: 他是个不懂礼貌、目中无人的年轻人。

ex.en: The manager's arrogant attitude alienated many of his colleagues.
ex.zh: 这位经理傲慢的态度使许多同事疏远了他。

ex.en: It would be arrogant to assume that our method is the only correct one.
ex.zh: 假设我们的方法是唯一正确的方法就太自负了。

ex.en: Follow the arrow on the map, and you will reach the museum entrance easily.
ex.zh: 照着地图上的箭头走，你就能轻松到达博物馆入口。
